findings.summary: Versioned source contains hard-coded credential material for an initial administrator and an AdminApps development integration fallback.
findings.remediation: Remove credential values from versioned sources, rotate any value that may have been used, require injected synthetic bootstrap credentials, and perform an approved repository secret scan without serializing values.

findings.summary: No authoritative deployment composition pins interpreter/base image, selects one backend dependency scope, provisions all declared stores and services, or performs two equivalent clean builds.
findings.remediation: Create a governance-approved WS-A deployment definition with pinned runtime/base images, dependency integrity, isolated AdminApps/ISO/Redis topology and target guard.

findings.summary: SQLite remains selectable in operational settings and the official regression suite is SQLite-only; production/deployment documentation does not enforce PostgreSQL.
findings.remediation: Before WS-A, define a deployment guard that rejects SQLite outside explicit unit-test settings and add PostgreSQL-backed deployment validation.

findings.summary: Access and refresh JWTs are currently persisted in browser localStorage and no secure alternative is implemented.
findings.remediation: Govern and implement the approved secure token transport/storage design in an authorized follow-up; do not remediate in this audit.

findings.summary: Backup destination, retention, encryption, naming, restore source and integrity verification are undefined; the current manual action records metadata only.
findings.remediation: Define executable backup/restore prerequisites and correct the operational contract before claiming backup readiness.

findings.summary: Celery tasks and outbox primitives exist, but service lifecycle, an outbox dispatcher entrypoint, restart supervision, backlog metrics and alerting are not defined.
findings.remediation: Declare worker/beat/dispatcher processes, externalize broker configuration, and define health, restart and backlog/failure signals.
